text:
maria: Heads up — scheduling a maintenance window for apac-west1 NIC firmware patch + coordinated graceful GPU node reboots.

maria: Window: Tue 2026-04-14 02:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic). Targeting cohort of 6 racks (24 nodes) in 2-rack batches.

raj: ack. What's the impact on hosted GPU pools? Any risk to Dedicated SLA tenants?

maria: Estimated steady-state throughput drop ~10-15% during each 30m cohort. Dedicated tenants will be routed to reserved capacity where possible; SLA tenants get priority fallback. No expected data-plane interruption beyond transient latency spikes.

jen: Can we avoid cold KV cache misses on bring-back? Recommend running kvseed per pool ~10m before marking nodes Ready. Also suggest warming prefix cache for frequent routes.

maria: agreed. Plan:
- cordon 2 racks
- drain pods with --grace-period=30
- apply NIC fw then soft-reboot nodes
- uncordon and run kvseed + prefix-warm job

maria: drain command we'll use (on coordinator):
```
for node in $(cat cohort_nodes); do kubectl drain $node --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30; done
```

raj: Sounds good. How do we handle burst traffic if an API customer hits a tail spike? Do we have fallback routing to eu/na regions?

maria: yes — SmartRouter will shift new requests to eu-west/ us-west for high-priority routes automatically if backend latency > 1.2s for >1m. We'll temporarily relax batching thresholds to reduce queueing.

jen: cost ask — switching bursts to other regions means additional egress & instance cost. Can we cap fallback to critical tenants only? Otherwise finance will flag the delta.

maria: We will restrict cross-region fallback to tier-1 tenants and internal traffic. Non-critical hosted requests will queue with degraded throughput. I'll attach a cost estimate after simulating the ~15% spillover.

deploy-bot: Patch job created: jobs/patch-1750000000-apac-nic-fw (cohort=1..3). ETA runbook: /runbooks/apac-nic-maint

oncall-bot: Oncall rota: raj (primary), jen (secondary). Pager escalation: 15m -> infra-lead -> eng-sre.

raj: I'll be on-call and will have direct SSH access to the coordinator. @maria pls post the cohort node lists 30m before start :thumbsup:

maria: posted cohort lists to the channel and uploaded to /ops/maint/1750000000/cohorts.csv

jen: I'll queue kvseed jobs and prefix-warm scripts. putting a preflight check at T-45m to validate kvcache seed success (>=90% hit on sample set).

maria: Preflight checklist (short):
- [x] cohort lists uploaded
- [x] ticket sent to customer notifications (non-critical) 
- [ ] cost sim results
- [x] patch binary staged on nodes

raj: 👍 ready. Will watch latency dashboards and open a rollback if tail latency >2s for >5m.

maria: Thanks — will run cohort 1 at 02:05 UTC, update thread when each cohort starts/finishes.
